name: Biocomposite Ultra High Density
filament_start_gcode: ; QZ biomaterial: cold extrusion, no filament-specific thermal ops
compatible_printers: QZmini @ Bambu Lab A1 mini 4.0 nozzle
QZmini @ Bambu Lab A1 mini 2.0 nozzle
filament_notes: Quasizero Biocomposite Ultra High Density. Hardware-calibrated on QZmini @ Bambu Lab A1 mini via torque-speed ladder: flow ratio 3.75 (material property - never raised with speed). Validated print point: 3 mm/s, 4.91 mm width, 3 mm layer (~166 mm3/s commanded). 4 mm/s printed but marginal; 4.5 mm/s @375% under-delivers (thin bead); tearing from ~276 mm3/s. Max volumetric speed 180 keeps every future slice inside the validated region with ~10% headroom. Hardware validated at the 3 mm/s point.
